question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**social media**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the rise of smartphones and the impact of technology on how we communicate and work.
 
• The phrase "smartphones and _____" implies the kind of technology that enables connection through applications like Facebook, which is most commonly associated with **social media**.</
